Overview.Name: Naveen Kumar
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Breakfast: Option 1: Omelette (2 eggs) + whole wheat toast (1)
Option 2: Oats porridge (60 g) with mixed nuts (10 g)
Option 3: Poha (80 g) with vegetables (50 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + mixed vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2) + paneer bhurji (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) + cucumber salad (50 g)
Dinner: Option 2: Grilled paneer (120 g) + steamed vegetables (100 g)
Option 3: Stir-fried mixed vegetables (150 g) + millet roti (2 small)

Notes_and_Tips: Use eggs as a primary protein source but keep portion moderate (2 eggs max per meal).
When eating 2 meals, prefer later meals (skip or keep breakfast light).
Limit late-night eating and refined sugars to support weight loss.
Aim for improved sleep duration to help metabolic health.
Include daily brisk walking for 20–30 minutes.
